title: Data quality
idea: Data quality: Source-specific missing or invalid records lead correction review
audience: People who need to repair data within a dashboard surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its repair data priority and explicit commitment contract: Corrected data must pass validation before clearing the issue
navigation: Data quality keeps the current repair data context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Source-specific missing or invalid records lead correction review
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to repair data; users diagnose measurable data defects
composition.priority: Corrected data must pass validation before clearing the issue

imagery.role: Support the actual repair data context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Group by impact and retain source provenance
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the data quality structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no repair data content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Corrected data must pass validation before clearing the issue
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized repair data content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Corrected data must pass validation before clearing the issue
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active repair data context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
